resolution.note: PR #164: strict full runs reject evidence unless all 28 isolation files ran with tests and 0 skips; krn/gate green on d454a95. Count publication: t-axd5bbb. Retirement of krn/gate-local: t-dqpk1dy (operator D30 decision).

title: Measure whether Jenkins runs every isolation test with zero skips
body:
Outcome: evidence whether the Jenkins krn/gate job runs every isolation test file that gate:local selects (scripts/gate-local.mjs selectIsolationTestFiles, 28 files at 98643ed), with zero isolation skips, on the exact head; if yes, a decision-ready D30 amendment that retires the local krn/gate-local requirement, then the PR that implements it (ruleset, deliver, docs, lead skill).
Operator 2026-11-02: "4. dawaj stary wszystko po kolei" (after the lead proposed measuring this and retiring krn/gate-local when Jenkins proves 0 skips).
Evidence: PR #163 deliver waited 30 min on the local load threshold and exited 75 (gate: bounded wait timed out) while krn/gate on Jenkins was already green; the krn/gate check-run text (4.5 KB) does not report the isolation skip count, so today the claim cannot be checked from GitHub.
Proof: the krn/gate check output (or an archived Jenkins artifact) names the isolation file count and "0 isolation skips" for one exact head; a red-first observer for whatever reporting change is needed.
